goal: Fix a memory leak causing the server to crash after roughly 6 hours of uptime.

entries.content: ran a heap snapshot diff across two hours of uptime — retained size dominated by EventEmitter listeners on the websocket connection object, growing linearly with connection count
read package.json — saw the dependency list and script names
ran: git log --oneline -5 — recent commits were unrelated copy-editing on the marketing site
read README.md — general project setup instructions, nothing about the websocket handler
ran: ls public/audio — unrelated, was checking something else earlier in the session
ran an 8-hour load test after adding removeListener() cleanup in the websocket disconnect handler — memory stayed flat, no crash
